name: rask-ui-phone-engine
description: Builds src/Rask.Ui/Resources/ui-phone.js and ui-phone-utils.js, the lazily loaded engine behind Ui.Phone: npm ci && node build.mjs. intl-tel-input is pinned to the release fluxui.dev serves (29.2.3, read off its phone.min.js); its utils are that release's own build of Google's libphonenumber.
